competing_explanation: The large privileged oracle gain may be predominantly target-conditioned optimization information rather than an observable haze-state signal; a contextual nonlinear head can also appear useful by learning synthetic-scene regularities without spatial specificity or cross-split safety.
controls: exact GitHub-main parent, split, oracle, and failed-proxy terminal identities
immutable official architecture anchor and strict official checkpoint load
deterministic five-fold scene grouping with 120 OOF scenes per fold
fixed 150-scene calibration role excluded from gradient fitting and primary estimation
within-image shuffled spatial action-map control with identical action counts
complete image replay for PSNR, RGB SSIM, and RGB mean-bias safety
candidate-confirmation asset absent from both contract and run contexts
disabled_actions: candidate-confirmation, canary, locked-test, NH-Haze, ITS, or OTS access
architecture, feature, optimizer, epoch, loss-weight, threshold, action-scale, calibration-quantile, fold, or variant search
using GT, GT-derived utility, or GT-derived risk as inference input
treating haze variants, tiles, actions, pixels, folds, or resamples as independent samples
changing the 0.05 dB utility margin or 0.025 dB precision target
claiming source disjointness, deployment readiness, promotion, or external confirmation
starting an ITS or OTS measurement without a later typed route-ready contract

gates.reference: all frozen terminal, source, checkpoint, and runtime identities match exactly
exact 600/150 train roles, balanced five-fold OOF, one selected train variant per scene, and 100 complete four-variant test-development scene groups
OOF utility LCB above 0.05 dB, material-scene Wilson LCB above 0.20, both spatial-control LCBs above zero, and frozen test-development point gain at least 0.025 dB
for OOF and test-development scenes separately, Wilson UCB95 is at most 0.10 for PSNR loss at least 0.10 dB, SSIM loss at least 0.005, and color-bias increase at least 1/255
maximum distance from the OOF paired-bootstrap point estimate to either 95 percent interval endpoint

fixed_factors: official ConvIR-B base backbone and Haze4K checkpoint remain frozen
observable head architecture is Conv2d 104-to-64, GroupNorm, GELU, Conv2d 64-to-64, GroupNorm, GELU, and Conv2d 64-to-4
actions remain keep 1.0, weaken 0.8, and strengthen 1.2 under clip(hazy + scale times official residual, 0, 1)
continuous tile target is PSNR change versus keep clipped to plus or minus 3 dB
harm target is action utility at or below minus 0.10 dB
training uses 12 fixed epochs, AdamW at 0.0003, weight decay 0.0001, and gradient norm clipping at 1.0
calibration uses the finite-sample 95 percent upper quantile of nonnegative scene-mean utility and risk residuals
an action requires corrected utility above 0.05 dB and corrected harm risk at most 0.10; otherwise the policy keeps
original clear scene is the only independent analysis unit
haze variants, tiles, actions, pixels, folds, and bootstrap resamples never increase sample size
the protected 150-scene Haze4K candidate-confirmation role, NH-Haze, ITS, and OTS remain unread
intervention.matched_budget: one outcome-blind haze variant for each of 600 primary OOF scenes and 150 fixed calibration scenes; all four nested variants averaged within each of 100 secondary test-development scenes
intervention.primary_variable: fixed contextual continuous-utility and harm-risk head with calibrated keep abstention
intervention.reference: official keep output, the identical predictor collapsed to one image-uniform action, and a within-image shuffled spatial action map

primary_estimand.aggregation: five-fold OOF original-clear-scene mean over one outcome-blind selected haze variant per Haze4K training-role scene

question: Can a single frozen contextual head, using only the hazy image, official ConvIR-B output, and frozen Decoder[2] features at inference, deliver precise scene-level spatial utility beyond keep and matched controls while calibrated abstention keeps image-replay harm below the frozen limits?
